title: Get Started
text:
Steps to Get Started

Set up an initial consultation meeting
To schedule an initial consultation meeting, visit this link.
We ask that you prepare the following prior to the initial meeting: - Project/research purpose - # of participants in possible workshop - Current research/teaching methods and tools


Schedule a workshop for you or your classroom
After the initial consultation meeting, we’ll collaborate on workshop or lab material for you and your class to use. From there, we can schedule a time for us to come and run through the material.
For individual or group researchers, we’ll schedule virtual or in-person training sessions to help you best use these resources.
Please provide us 2 weeks lead time to prepare classroom workshop materials.


Review documentation
Check out this resource for more technical and detailed information on using some of the CI tools.

title: Research Cyberinfrastructure at Chaminade University
text:
Cyberinfrastructure (CI) is a system of people and technologies brought together to perform computational analyses of big data in order to achieve breakthrough science and solve large-scale problems.
In other words, CI involves high-performance computing (HPC), supercomputers, massive data storage and data management systems, specialized applications for modeling, simulation, and analysis, and experts and support staff who help develop and operate these systems.

title: Research Cyberinfrastructure at Chaminade University
text:
About Chaminade University
Chaminade University of Honolulu is part of the Cyberinfrastructure Pacific Professionals (CIPP) in partnership with University of Hawaii, University of Guam, and Texas Advanced Computing Center. CIPP is a collaborative initiative dedication to strengthening CI capabilities across the Hawaii/Guam and US Affiliated Pacific Islands region.
